name: Docker Socket Permissions 660 or Stricter
description: Ensures the Docker control socket /var/run/docker.sock is owned by root with group docker (or root) and mode 660 or stricter; any user who can write to it controls the host as root. Passes with LEA_RULE_no_service when dockerd is not running.

validation.command: if cat /proc/*/comm 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^dockerd$'; then stat -c '%a %U %G' /var/run/docker.sock; else echo 'LEA_RULE_no_service'; fi
